import os,re,json,numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import label
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(I):
    I=[row[:] for row in I]; R,C=len(I),len(I[0]); O=[r[:] for r in I]
    arr=np.array(I); lab,n=label(arr==0, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    ringset=set()
    for k in range(1,n+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(lab==k)
        comp=list(zip(rs.tolist(),cs.tolist()))
        if len(comp)<2: continue
        okc=any(((a+dr,b+dc) in set(map(tuple,comp)) for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]) for a,b in comp)
        if not okc: continue
        a1,a2=min(r for r,_ in comp)-1,max(r for r,_ in comp)+1
        b1,b2=min(c for _,c in comp)-1,max(c for _,c in comp)+1
        ringset.update([(a,b) for a in range(max(0,a1),min(R-1,a2+1)) for b in range(max(0,b1),min(C-1,b2+1))])
    for a,b in ringset:
        if I[a][b]!=0: O[a][b]=3
    return O
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))
